mostWorthwhile.text: Extending the potato collar and adding medium was the most worthwhile sequence: each piece had a clear role in keeping developing tubers dark while leaving the leaves exposed.

leastWorthwhile.text: The soybean support was straightforward and offered little discovery beyond the visible need for support.

surprise.text: The raised collar's room for additional medium clarified why extending the skirt alone was not enough.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; both crop interventions had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: the practical growing details were satisfying, though I would hope for more discovery than this short, predictable sequence offered.
